headlines.title: ConocoPhillips and Devon Energy Earnings Previews: What Shareholders Should Watch
headlines.summary: ConocoPhillips and Devon Energy both beat estimates last quarter, but swinging oil prices and activist pressure now threaten the generous payouts each company promised shareholders. Here is what the Nov. 5 reports need to show for those commitments to hold.

headlines.title: Insights Into ConocoPhillips (COP) Q3: Wall Street Projections for Key Metrics
headlines.summary: Beyond analysts' top-and-bottom-line estimates for ConocoPhillips (COP), evaluate projections for some of its key metrics to gain a better insight into how the business might have performed for the quarter ended September 2026.

headlines.title: How Investors Are Reacting To ConocoPhillips Stock Ahead Of Earnings
headlines.summary: ConocoPhillips is set to report third quarter results on 5 November under new CEO Andy O'Brien, with the update arriving as crude prices remain elevated and the producer continues to focus on upstream oil and gas operations. The combination of anticipated earnings strength, a supportive oil pricing backdrop and fresh ETF buying highlights how ConocoPhillips' operating profile and capital discipline are drawing renewed attention as leadership changes at the top.

headlines.title: EOG Resources Earnings Ahead: What Past Reactions Say About The Stock
headlines.summary: EOG Resources (NYSE:EOG) is scheduled to report its earnings on Thursday, November 5, 2026. The company has a market value of about $81.6 billion. Over the last twelve months it generated $26.6 billion in revenue and $9.4 billion in operating profit, with net income of $6.9 billion.

description: ConocoPhillips explores for, produces, transports, and markets crude oil, bitumen, natural gas, liquefied natural gas (LNG), and natural gas liquids. It operates in five segments: Alaska; Lower 48; Canada; Europe, Middle East and North Africa; and Asia Pacific. The company's portfolio includes unconventional plays in North America; conventional assets in North America, Europe, Asia, and Australia; global LNG developments; oil sands assets in Canada; and an inventory of global exploration prospects. It serves in the United States, Canada, China, Equatorial Guinea, Libya, Malaysia, Norway, Singapore, the United Kingdom, and internationally. ConocoPhillips was founded in 1917 and is headquartered in Houston, Texas.
